Author: Serpens66
Name: Extra Features
Description: Optional gameplay additions and economy customization for Stronghold Crusader Definitive Edition.

Changes: Added a throttled side-by-side log of Vanilla's unreachable-building demolition decision and the mod's gatehouse/drawbridge PCL classification, including the virtual gate path used.
Added configurable protection against AI demolition of buildings that Vanilla considers unreachable, including temporary closed-gate and raised-drawbridge detection.
Separated synchronized packet registration from optional local hooks, removed disabled feature work, and restored modified Lord health when its multipliers are disabled.
Kept Lord health multipliers explicitly inactive in the map editor and corrected the gatehouse automation schema initialization log.
Fixed and diagnosed the per-gate automation button in the map editor, restricted it to the active editor player's gates, and persisted manual-only choices in map files through stable gate locators.
Added map-editor diagnostics for knight controls and single-building pause actions.
Moved multiplayer game-speed controls, Ctrl single-unit market trading, and ally goods-transfer amount modifiers to Bugfixes and QoL.
Matched the gatehouse automation button tooltip to the shared opaque, bordered, wrapping, resolution-scaled modsettings tooltip presentation.
Added a game-styled gatehouse-and-cog icon for the per-gate automation button.
Enabled owned gatehouse automation, quarry relocation, knight mount/dismount, Ctrl market trading, and single-building pause controls for the active player in the map editor.
Added 0.25-second game-speed keybind repeats while increase or decrease is held, using 5-point steps normally, 25-point steps with Shift, and tick-synchronized Chores in multiplayer.
Added host-configurable human and AI gatehouse closing distances and reopening delays, with displayed seconds defined at gamespeed 40.
Added default-on pathfinding-aware gatehouse closing so unreachable enemies do not close protected inner gates.
Added a synchronized per-gate button that switches owned human gatehouses between automatic and manual-only control and persists the choice in savegames.
Extended synchronized normal and Shift game-speed changes beyond 90 up to Script Extender's configured maximum.
Added a default-on host setting that changes the normal game-speed keybinds in 25-point steps while Shift is held, with tick-synchronized Chore execution in multiplayer.
Added separate 10-500% host settings for human and AI Lord health while preserving each AI Lord's Vanilla health differences and wounded Lords' current health ratio.

Added a default-on host setting that lets every human player change multiplayer game speed with the normal keybinds or the in-game options slider through Script Extender's tick-aligned Chore transport.

Fixed normal-click building sleeping in multiplayer: synchronized per-building overrides are now cleared for the selected building type before Vanilla's optional type-wide sleep action, matching the singleplayer behavior without changing already-awake buildings when waking a type.
Enabled knight mount/dismount and single-building pause in multiplayer by executing their state-changing actions through Script Extender's tick-aligned Chore transport.
Enabled quarry-pile relocation in multiplayer by executing button actions through Script Extender's tick-aligned Chore transport.
Added default-on local Shift (5x) and Ctrl (0.2x) amount modifiers for ally goods transfers, including live button labels and an in-panel modifier hint.
Added a synchronized, default-off option that lets both Monk skins use the normal troop running decision and running animation.
Made numeric setting values and per-good market multipliers directly editable while retaining sliders for quick adjustments.
Added temporary Script Extender compatibility fixes for multiplayer settings synchronization during lobby joins, reliable lobby delivery, and authenticated in-game host updates.

Added a synchronized option that lets AI players keep Vanilla market prices while human players use the configured global and per-good prices; AI buy decisions, payments, and sale proceeds now use the selected price model consistently.
Added optional Serps Mods Host dependency for Workshop mod-pack load ordering.
Added synchronized per-good buy and sell price multipliers that combine with the general market factors, and moved the market-price settings to the bottom of the settings view.
Updated shared lobby settings for Script Extender 1.42.0 by avoiding redundant UI-only persistence and using the official multiplayer-game signal.
Added setting for instant horse after dismount

Added a synchronized setting for single-building pause and temporarily disabled it, knight transformations, quarry-pile relocation, and linked quarry demolition in real multiplayer pending validation of Script Extender's Chore transport.
Clarified the temporary multiplayer limitation in the affected setting tooltips.
Removed the desync-prone custom multiplayer packet paths for knight transformations and quarry-pile relocation pending a validated tick-aligned transport.
Updated query IDs, unit spawning, stable links, and deterministic packet registration for Script Extender 1.41.0.
Moved the knight mount/dismount option into a dedicated new-gameplay-features section, added Slider units, highlighted activation, and enlarged tooltips.
Moved the campfire-peasant limit from UnitLimit into ExtraFeatures and reorganized the Host settings by topic.
Added opaque, automatically wrapping tooltips and clarified that churches receive additional priests.
Use validated reference RVAs on the audited DLL and scan native signatures only for compatible changed DLLs.
Changed the default plague-cloud duration multiplier to 2.0x and the default apothecary plague-search range to 50.
Added a synchronized 20-200 slider for the apothecary plague-search range; 30 keeps Vanilla behavior.
Added a synchronized 0.5x-20.0x multiplier for the native lifetime of all plague clouds.
Delegated optional mission-preset coordination to CustomCustomTrail; local presets remain standalone.
Added mission-bound Trail presets from .modjson and CustomCustomTrail schema-2 missions, including shared customization UI.
Added two automatically saved lobby-settings presets with migration of existing settings to preset 1.
Split optional gameplay and economy features from Some Settings into a dedicated mod.
Fast Recruit Rally Movement now uses the optional shared movement hook from Bugfixes and QoL and disables only itself when that mod is missing.
